description: Get a single work item by id or by code (`CXE-014`; a code the item gave up when it was re-keyed onto a team's code still finds it, returned under its current `code` with the former ones in `codeAliases`), including the test evidence people recorded on it (`testEvidence`, newest first), the names of its people (`assigneeName`, `blockerOwnerName` and `createdByName` beside `assigneeUid`, `blockerOwnerUid` and `createdBy`; null when the field is empty or names someone who is not an approved member) and the team it answers to (`team`: `{ id, name, source }`, where `source` is `item` for a team set on the item and `initiative` for its initiative's team; `null` when neither has one). `nextActions` says what YOU can do to its status now, so you never need the Console to find a transition: `statusMoves` lists each status the Console status menu offers that your key may reach, as `{ to, send }`, where `send` is the exact anyforge_update_work_item arguments (besides itemId) that make the move; `withheld` lists menu moves the write would refuse now with the code it would answer (work_item_deferred, approve_and_route_required, intake_draft_incomplete, test_evidence_required); `restore` is `reopen` or `undrop` for finished or dropped work you may bring back; `unavailable` says why there are no moves (`read_only`, `not_steward`, `crew_carries`, `finished`, `dropped`). `checklist` and `checklistRevision` (absent reads as 0) are what action='checklist' and 'checklist-promote' work from.

itemId.description: The work item id or code.

name: anyforge_get_work_item
title: Get work item
